82f0854b21b5ffdee17f3b3ff531aa5ee025410a.speaker: ROWAN
82f0854b21b5ffdee17f3b3ff531aa5ee025410a.text: It's open now. Geometric patterns pulse softly. It looks... expectant.

68ad2c0b802ffae567ce9687bad837987bc69893.speaker: ROWAN
68ad2c0b802ffae567ce9687bad837987bc69893.text: The medallion is in place. The relic hums faintly but needs something more.

01f8637641b36766706ced581c768bc26452d134.speaker: ROWAN
01f8637641b36766706ced581c768bc26452d134.text: The recess is clean. Something circular fits here. Something old and familiar.

a023a6fad9fc641d1a4683efd6d5577ea1176df4.speaker: ROWAN
a023a6fad9fc641d1a4683efd6d5577ea1176df4.text: The sand is dry and cracked. I could scrape it out with something flat.

c0af74033ec0c2375295b0b21c5ca8cfd2693355.speaker: ROWAN
c0af74033ec0c2375295b0b21c5ca8cfd2693355.text: Smooth, seamless, and smug. I've met wealthy people less polished than this.

ef633f15ff0882740804fc99687067e41ee5b032.speaker: ROWAN
ef633f15ff0882740804fc99687067e41ee5b032.text: There's a circular recess packed with wet sand and fine salt crust.

48f4d3a3b4a6b368a320b6f4e09f1593c823cbd1.speaker: ROWAN
48f4d3a3b4a6b368a320b6f4e09f1593c823cbd1.text: A sailor's spyglass. Lens cracked, brass cheap, still more trustworthy than most officials.

67478c1fcb166083acb493c886743ae448030519.speaker: ROWAN
67478c1fcb166083acb493c886743ae448030519.text: One of Blackwake's many wheels for deciding whether pipes are happy.

f0e11fbec4b3a63ed248852a1d267564a94a0c60.speaker: ROWAN
f0e11fbec4b3a63ed248852a1d267564a94a0c60.text: 'NO UNAUTHORIZED RESONANCE EVENTS.' That's not reassuring. That's advertising.

ed2253da9caae1bedfd6ed66dcdbbf015157b74e.speaker: ROWAN
ed2253da9caae1bedfd6ed66dcdbbf015157b74e.text: Fishing boats and salvage barges. The two honest trades of Blackwake.

fcb16a5b2f89d619c3c6bc40a7d8139e70662f1a.speaker: ROWAN
fcb16a5b2f89d619c3c6bc40a7d8139e70662f1a.text: A shack small enough to be humble but official enough to be dangerous.

7ae665c4ead134138c2b66cd15504763e6a94bb6.speaker: ROWAN
7ae665c4ead134138c2b66cd15504763e6a94bb6.text: Brick, steam, and ambition holding back the tide. Barely.

9188db77d0d3f31a908be4f6fe3444aa49d7fcc5.speaker: ROWAN
9188db77d0d3f31a908be4f6fe3444aa49d7fcc5.text: A man whose hair appears to be having an independent adventure.

064d252cdde8e3813e019f73b0a5bc9eeec47bce.speaker: ROWAN
064d252cdde8e3813e019f73b0a5bc9eeec47bce.text: Pindle is deep in a furious debate about fish ownership. Good.

1da0b57db6d49219b714da3ed24cc8864f2df6c8.speaker: ROWAN
1da0b57db6d49219b714da3ed24cc8864f2df6c8.text: A uniform containing a small man and a large sense of jurisdiction.

ee879e4ab40151c84321aafaf7b73e0f785a6276.speaker: ROWAN
ee879e4ab40151c84321aafaf7b73e0f785a6276.text: Opportunists, mystics, and people pretending they were here first.

0e49cbc563f7143902852543cea1c81a00715456.speaker: ROWAN
0e49cbc563f7143902852543cea1c81a00715456.text: A fishmonger near the front looks particularly territorial.

9c208d0c69f422db22ada616920ab65ed759d2d9.speaker: ROWAN
9c208d0c69f422db22ada616920ab65ed759d2d9.text: Pindle's inspection stamp. A block of wood on a handle. The chosen scepter of tiny authority.

4adf626b77fe0a1b8eb3b8ae6118188a660f3ed3.speaker: ROWAN
4adf626b77fe0a1b8eb3b8ae6118188a660f3ed3.text: Pindle's stamp is sitting unattended on his crate. Interesting.

750a70115496d452a6641feb583bb260cc3b6ece.speaker: ROWAN
750a70115496d452a6641feb583bb260cc3b6ece.text: The crowd is enjoying the Pindle-Fishmonger show. Best entertainment all week.

96d6cef37144c894633e2d9f467961dadde67be9.speaker: ROWAN
96d6cef37144c894633e2d9f467961dadde67be9.text: I'm not saying it bit me. I'm saying we now have a hostile understanding.

47c579284373a26e0bd924f17fa2af62a741bae1.speaker: ROWAN
47c579284373a26e0bd924f17fa2af62a741bae1.text: A cracked spyglass. Might still focus enough light to be useful.

46a20ec0e0018ad2c0b37426635d484893d2ed73.speaker: ROWAN
46a20ec0e0018ad2c0b37426635d484893d2ed73.text: It's bolted to the seawall. Blackwake takes its warnings very seriously and its safety not at all.

f85c33991018db7455f7f6a02aacf81f9e7b5b68.speaker: ROWAN
f85c33991018db7455f7f6a02aacf81f9e7b5b68.text: It's the size of a horse and embedded in sand. I'll need a different approach.

6d2075c65d25af45d4c393e6af610b35ac3a7a8c.speaker: ROWAN
6d2075c65d25af45d4c393e6af610b35ac3a7a8c.text: I grab the stamp while Pindle's busy arguing. He won't miss it for minutes.

2052d1f1d654153906b8f7f6f2910a26e8b57c8d.speaker: ROWAN
2052d1f1d654153906b8f7f6f2910a26e8b57c8d.text: I can't pick up an entire bureaucrat. Tempting though.

b25a887642f42e7570797712f92f180a33900e00.speaker: ROWAN
b25a887642f42e7570797712f92f180a33900e00.text: Time to check the salvage warehouse.

59169d0d0d7014eea93875a18e58f21c5d839b44.speaker: ROWAN
59169d0d0d7014eea93875a18e58f21c5d839b44.text: The docks lead to the salvage warehouse, but I need a permit first.

c78b9642481264d0a6196d10f97359800eb2917f.speaker: ROWAN
c78b9642481264d0a6196d10f97359800eb2917f.text: Let's see if a resonance tone wakes it.

29dff1380577293e76c2daa1d6c3177bcaefbf90.speaker: ROWAN
29dff1380577293e76c2daa1d6c3177bcaefbf90.text: The valve blares. The relic shudders but nothing happens. Something needs to go in that recess first.

defafaba365dd9c449c5450bb8976e83b2e44748.speaker: ROWAN
defafaba365dd9c449c5450bb8976e83b2e44748.text: The crane horn blares. Gulls scatter. Nothing else happens.

40fbd5a0c217c2e475d7bcfe9ed847fa7d233f22.speaker: ROWAN
40fbd5a0c217c2e475d7bcfe9ed847fa7d233f22.text: Use what on it? I should pick a specific item first.

744b7b9951b553c5f816adcb3d3475d6f95f0512.speaker: ROWAN
744b7b9951b553c5f816adcb3d3475d6f95f0512.text: Inside the crate: a cracked spyglass and the lingering scent of disappointment.

c84eb22bbb1553743c8389999702ae441f6a2d38.speaker: ROWAN
c84eb22bbb1553743c8389999702ae441f6a2d38.text: It doesn't have a lid. It has intent.

0833ecb0970ca6db9aa1467b79624f49fbe98fe4.speaker: ROWAN
0833ecb0970ca6db9aa1467b79624f49fbe98fe4.text: That was for confidence. Mine, not its.

157e7742efd1a4be1d16cf6b70182e7fcb2bfbd3.speaker: ROWAN
157e7742efd1a4be1d16cf6b70182e7fcb2bfbd3.text: Tempting, but assault on officials requires paperwork I don't have.

b8f9688de7a48487673615a5cbcbdf81853e50df.speaker: ROWAN
b8f9688de7a48487673615a5cbcbdf81853e50df.text: Pushing through this lot would require a permit. Probably.

dd47a42fef6fb6ec889625146a494cbf34c58540.speaker: ROWAN
dd47a42fef6fb6ec889625146a494cbf34c58540.text: The cracked lens focuses the morning sun onto the wet sand in the recess.

413e5f8212be204f457ef74dc776bfb6ae374395.speaker: ROWAN
413e5f8212be204f457ef74dc776bfb6ae374395.text: It starts to dry and crack. Good.

a4e637fcfab5bb684c6f9583cc787ff56101d4f2.speaker: ROWAN
a4e637fcfab5bb684c6f9583cc787ff56101d4f2.text: The sand is already dry. I need to scrape it out now.

3879a225ee01591f926afb37a2561d7f4eaefc7d.speaker: ROWAN
3879a225ee01591f926afb37a2561d7f4eaefc7d.text: The flat edge of the stamp handle scrapes the dried sand out of the recess perfectly.

a7bc92878b8a5ec498fe8c017f81a785fbd3ba9c.speaker: ROWAN
a7bc92878b8a5ec498fe8c017f81a785fbd3ba9c.text: Underneath: a circular groove with geometric patterns. My medallion would fit.

04eab9a042a1b0e63dbb3b207e36cae968f6e59c.speaker: ROWAN
04eab9a042a1b0e63dbb3b207e36cae968f6e59c.text: The sand is still wet. The stamp just smears it around. I need to dry it first.

fdfe1b4fd3963f985d048a4e4628daf049d9ad76.speaker: ROWAN
fdfe1b4fd3963f985d048a4e4628daf049d9ad76.text: The medallion slides into the groove with a satisfying click.

b9c06ffc78c57903d25576dff561289bee3dee15.speaker: ROWAN
b9c06ffc78c57903d25576dff561289bee3dee15.text: The relic hums. Faint lines of blue-white light trace across its surface.

865703fe79a59a3df7851cdb95ccdfbcd73a5eea.speaker: ROWAN
865703fe79a59a3df7851cdb95ccdfbcd73a5eea.text: Something I've apparently been meant to do since childhood.

26b788e7e39369c247666f2b4fb294d8ce4ef95f.speaker: ROWAN
26b788e7e39369c247666f2b4fb294d8ce4ef95f.text: I'm not grinding a mystery heirloom into dried sand. I should scrape the recess clean first.

601a682012ff8b6f266726474e597cc92d6e748d.speaker: ROWAN
601a682012ff8b6f266726474e597cc92d6e748d.text: I'm not grinding a mystery heirloom into wet beach paste.

d8f5c482237c4ea1b656939306514feddd2cb908.speaker: ROWAN
d8f5c482237c4ea1b656939306514feddd2cb908.text: The relic doesn't respond to that.

04a572f6d481fc9bca8d467c640f06799c651eae.speaker: ROWAN
04a572f6d481fc9bca8d467c640f06799c651eae.text: The valve works on its own. I just need to pull it.

05b8a4b3673c44be1eae8bd4b2ec2650e288c8ab.speaker: ROWAN
05b8a4b3673c44be1eae8bd4b2ec2650e288c8ab.text: Let's see if Pindle respects his own paperwork.

6ca10329f3c9519760405ad14ecb0bfca6e2eedf.speaker: ROWAN
6ca10329f3c9519760405ad14ecb0bfca6e2eedf.text: The relic unfolds. White lines spiral outward. A hovering map fragment appears.

b4902d02b041ba94a79c0c3fe5880469aeabb706.speaker: ROWAN
b4902d02b041ba94a79c0c3fe5880469aeabb706.text: White stone steps. Children running. A woman fastens the medallion on young Rowan.

1ec3afa3d282f83be1a73c642f5b4625712d5a69.speaker: ROWAN
1ec3afa3d282f83be1a73c642f5b4625712d5a69.text: 'When the sea remembers, you must return.'

768ca7c85d0f07d9a17bdb9921e9afc82d241c7d.speaker: ROWAN
768ca7c85d0f07d9a17bdb9921e9afc82d241c7d.text: The relic ejects the medallion and an engraved brass strip. Symbols match the map fragment.

c2fc1c7d20ec1927f8f05b5016556ad18cf505b7.speaker: ROWAN
c2fc1c7d20ec1927f8f05b5016556ad18cf505b7.text: Good. The sea has started giving me homework.

1caa4295bd3fe7c19288e6c48afc75bdb522d8f7.speaker: ROWAN
1caa4295bd3fe7c19288e6c48afc75bdb522d8f7.text: So I need to make my own. Charming.

d2132ee47303a63ad4bbbad91db36561bed03b6e.speaker: PINDLE
d2132ee47303a63ad4bbbad91db36561bed03b6e.text: Stand back! No one is to touch the object until it has been documented, classified, categorized, and denied!

dcbaa61231da15fca60bb8cfed5da5ba993a9fe9.speaker: TIBBIT
dcbaa61231da15fca60bb8cfed5da5ba993a9fe9.text: Mystery. Bureaucracy. Possibly treasure. In that order.

0bb3bc03c38da65714e580c3f8a26ebcb693c07a.speaker: PINDLE
0bb3bc03c38da65714e580c3f8a26ebcb693c07a.text: Citizen, step away from the object.

e4c3330a0723876fe852fda9141c33f6573dbdd8.speaker: ROWAN
e4c3330a0723876fe852fda9141c33f6573dbdd8.text: That seems like a flaw in your profession.

96849a0e2ae805041338e45bd7d8cde101fffd06.speaker: ROWAN
96849a0e2ae805041338e45bd7d8cde101fffd06.text: ...I've had this thing since I was a child.

33ef71c5c1fa172e251b3c28960d3c487abf5995.speaker: PINDLE
33ef71c5c1fa172e251b3c28960d3c487abf5995.text: Excellent. Then under salvage law, you are now personally responsible for whatever catastrophe this becomes.

6dbf4f7f6243b31db5f0909c5110745d3e884fa1.speaker: PINDLE
6dbf4f7f6243b31db5f0909c5110745d3e884fa1.text: NOT NOW! This man claims fish have property rights!

4c44eddeefbee35964451a5b4a378270d27a0086.speaker: TIBBIT
4c44eddeefbee35964451a5b4a378270d27a0086.text: Excellent. We have successfully alarmed the seagulls.

0ab4b6a4a4e02405d0931977ad52d23a71f16be4.speaker: PINDLE
0ab4b6a4a4e02405d0931977ad52d23a71f16be4.text: That shack is for authorized personnel. Which you are not.

0e1ee2f5647c860fb8ae608718a3c49d54dc59b8.speaker: PINDLE
0e1ee2f5647c860fb8ae608718a3c49d54dc59b8.text: Door stays shut until paperwork opens it.

89c90efca879afa82ee08550ddf2088581f509d8.speaker: TIBBIT
89c90efca879afa82ee08550ddf2088581f509d8.text: That's new! That's very new! What did you do?

fb706156ad2a03d139b8eff93f12724b6cb0eda6.speaker: TIBBIT
fb706156ad2a03d139b8eff93f12724b6cb0eda6.text: It's humming! That's either progress or a countdown.

1053c019bb3f8971b361092b3310b4fe4300bfbb.speaker: TIBBIT
1053c019bb3f8971b361092b3310b4fe4300bfbb.text: Physically, yes. Spiritually, your expression went somewhere expensive.

a7c7ec098c5d7c9441032a0231a0bdc8d47eb85b.speaker: TIBBIT
a7c7ec098c5d7c9441032a0231a0bdc8d47eb85b.text: The warehouse has salvage records. We might find a match for those symbols.

f3364a6aee577d7e4e3c36958f9e20ecf692ef8f.speaker: TIBBIT
f3364a6aee577d7e4e3c36958f9e20ecf692ef8f.text: But Pindle won't let you in without a permit. Which he also won't give you.

0f345192e12cf7d5c3e2c58959b27e6b963c1b01.speaker: ROWAN
0f345192e12cf7d5c3e2c58959b27e6b963c1b01.text: I've seen more interesting things at the bottom of a teacup.

01e3611e5a74b2d28ddc72b75885becc25110731.speaker: ROWAN
01e3611e5a74b2d28ddc72b75885becc25110731.text: It exists. I can confirm that much.

7f7cbf6fcb63cbc687a845409f245dd8106822a9.speaker: ROWAN
7f7cbf6fcb63cbc687a845409f245dd8106822a9.text: Exactly as boring as it looks.

63378bf1f562ff274a30f1a572fa458589393155.speaker: ROWAN
63378bf1f562ff274a30f1a572fa458589393155.text: I tried. It left me on read.

a371ec6296690ddfa243ce0b4f407f9d58467af2.speaker: ROWAN
a371ec6296690ddfa243ce0b4f407f9d58467af2.text: Even I have standards for conversation partners.

365f2dcee1dd432054acd43510a7840c1ec1760a.speaker: ROWAN
365f2dcee1dd432054acd43510a7840c1ec1760a.text: If it could talk, I suspect it would ask me to stop.

1e3b1334473d8a04dd994c118b5433e377a43fd4.speaker: ROWAN
1e3b1334473d8a04dd994c118b5433e377a43fd4.text: That's attached to the concept of 'staying put.'

5cf230b53c5a32f4b08661ea50ef8aecbe99703b.speaker: ROWAN
5cf230b53c5a32f4b08661ea50ef8aecbe99703b.text: Tibbit would name that impulse. Something like 'Acquisitive Folly Syndrome.'

e528d514944229b259bf724779a80d2561a546a1.speaker: ROWAN
e528d514944229b259bf724779a80d2561a546a1.text: Heavy. Bolted. Uncooperative. My three least favorite adjectives.

792cf47572bc98cc5334bd0c1867ee227884d3a9.speaker: ROWAN
792cf47572bc98cc5334bd0c1867ee227884d3a9.text: I could try, but my chiropractor would file a grievance.

7a0d80fb3fe9c5953d1f4c76b21b58006ada5063.speaker: ROWAN
7a0d80fb3fe9c5953d1f4c76b21b58006ada5063.text: I don't know how to use that on its own.

0c383cdb947fcf91defe168f064fb3fa9da47643.speaker: ROWAN
0c383cdb947fcf91defe168f064fb3fa9da47643.text: I stare at it purposefully. Nothing happens.

1524664c6af1ba8229d8564c62ad696b2a112ef3.speaker: ROWAN
1524664c6af1ba8229d8564c62ad696b2a112ef3.text: If there's a way to use that, it's been classified above my pay grade.

bf31055804309265636a62003624a197ca5e6df0.speaker: ROWAN
bf31055804309265636a62003624a197ca5e6df0.text: I could use it wrong, but where's the fun in that? Actually, everywhere.

f4ae244c78810fdb65a9bdc85c5754a32d2848d1.speaker: ROWAN
f4ae244c78810fdb65a9bdc85c5754a32d2848d1.text: The instruction manual for that is in a language I don't speak.

774e0889cb0d58afa2c13c3070210ad9cf048975.speaker: ROWAN
774e0889cb0d58afa2c13c3070210ad9cf048975.text: Sealed by either physics or spite.

affe18331cf83eeed19a8f3e5a15acf75e119106.speaker: ROWAN
affe18331cf83eeed19a8f3e5a15acf75e119106.text: Not everything opens. This is one of those things.

1cae40ecaa2562fdb46e209130a06083e72ab71e.speaker: ROWAN
1cae40ecaa2562fdb46e209130a06083e72ab71e.text: I pull, I push, I bargain. Nothing.

6c57dfb27ccf2dc730be600752d572e6aa1ebdc0.speaker: ROWAN
6c57dfb27ccf2dc730be600752d572e6aa1ebdc0.text: If Pindle had paperwork for opening that, I'd forge it.

20909f2c7d0ecbe485786b6d2b91e4501eadaed3.speaker: ROWAN
20909f2c7d0ecbe485786b6d2b91e4501eadaed3.text: Pushing that accomplishes nothing except proving I tried.

8f3a2b78cf8812640633c50768618876d25edab3.speaker: ROWAN
8f3a2b78cf8812640633c50768618876d25edab3.text: I push. It pushes back. We reach an impasse.

5fa148149e80b6a1bcbce46abf019688fd11608c.speaker: ROWAN
5fa148149e80b6a1bcbce46abf019688fd11608c.text: Unmoved. Like a customs inspector at a bribe.

536c1e94a998747fa36c1d7803235d3f89c5c0d9.speaker: ROWAN
536c1e94a998747fa36c1d7803235d3f89c5c0d9.text: I give it a shove. It gives me indifference.

39bb74ba1b2ba8ec2f4719091569fbe64afc1372.speaker: ROWAN
39bb74ba1b2ba8ec2f4719091569fbe64afc1372.text: My pushing technique is flawless. The object simply refuses to cooperate.

a6857ea2a5c402bbd760acf1f7b797c31d4e8389.speaker: ROWAN
a6857ea2a5c402bbd760acf1f7b797c31d4e8389.text: That combination makes about as much sense as Pindle's filing system.

ba9d8861b361d332581327d5503328989e7bece6.speaker: ROWAN
ba9d8861b361d332581327d5503328989e7bece6.text: I tried. The universe said no.

185b33777a84d10b3991908bc17412793d629b39.speaker: ROWAN
185b33777a84d10b3991908bc17412793d629b39.text: Those two things have nothing to say to each other.

6c9fab77cb6e585a8d0856cbfd13654de2aadc5d.speaker: ROWAN
6c9fab77cb6e585a8d0856cbfd13654de2aadc5d.text: I don't think combining those will help.

cdf6b96e56e964fc1dea7be67c3a96dac4a4cf9d.speaker: ROWAN
cdf6b96e56e964fc1dea7be67c3a96dac4a4cf9d.text: Those don't go together. Like oil and Pindle's competence.

b750de393412833af9b459f189929adbd61b4669.speaker: ROWAN
b750de393412833af9b459f189929adbd61b4669.text: I hold them near each other. They maintain a professional distance.

b124d026dbac53044692b7af52d765a29e9170ce.speaker: ROWAN
b124d026dbac53044692b7af52d765a29e9170ce.text: Tibbit would call that 'creative engineering.' I call it nonsense.

53becb748062f40ed30866b6be1798da06c8427b.speaker: ROWAN
53becb748062f40ed30866b6be1798da06c8427b.text: One plus one does not always equal useful.
